verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform docs list regular and off-cycle employee payroll alongside contractor payment management as core capabilities of the same platform. Dedicated guides cover employee payroll runs (pre-generated regular payrolls, employee tax setup) and contractor payments (direct deposit/check methods, payment-group preview, submission blockers, receipts). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of 1099 form generation/filing for contractors, and independent hands-on corroboration of paying both worker types together (docs are framed for the Embedded partner API rather than a direct ops-user UI).
